summary: A resident in {place} finds the phone charging site on a paper notice.
realLife: New York City used printed notices to publicize charging locations when residents could not get information online.
gates: A posted notice gives a confirmed local charging location.
inGame: needs: a posted notice gives a confirmed local charging location.

turns.what: The resident takes the address along.
turns.writesBack: The resident has a current charging address.

turns.what: Replace the notice at the same posting spot.
turns.writesBack: The outdated posting is marked for replacement.
